title: Flemish Municipalities Recycling-Centre Server Breach
description: A Ghost Hunters group member ('BabidiGhost'), reportedly aided by the DeepSeek AI model, accessed a central server of a service provider used by recycling centres across 82 Flemish municipalities. Discovered by Secutec and SOCRadar; CCB notified.
impact: Identity card details of around 1.2 million residents and staff stolen; all Flemish provinces affected, East Flanders hardest hit.

title: Pal System Co-op Data Leak via KARTE Vendor Breach
description: Japanese co-op delivery service Pal System disclosed a leak after unauthorised access to Plaid Inc.'s KARTE service, which it uses for ordering-site and app notifications. KARTE was suspended on 13 November.
impact: 1,997,972 records leaked (member numbers and attributes such as delivery office, birth month, gender, nickname); no names, addresses or payment data.

title: Yamato Holdings Chat Service Breach
description: Logistics giant Yamato said servers of its third-party chat provider ChatPlus were accessed by an attacker on 13 November; Yamato suspended its customer chat channels.
impact: Names, addresses and phone numbers of foreign-language chat customers possibly leaked; no card data or passwords.

title: CIA Unclassified OSINT System Breach
description: An unclassified CIA system handling open-source intelligence was breached in a cyberattack, according to a source who spoke to AP. The issue is said to be resolved.
impact: Unclassified OSINT system compromised; no classified information involved, per the source.

title: Turnitin Customer-Facing Systems Intrusion
description: Education technology firm Turnitin disclosed unauthorised activity involving certain customer-facing systems; investigation under way with external specialists, and law enforcement and regulators notified.
impact: Scope not yet disclosed; platform used by 16,000+ institutions and 71 million students. Services remain operational.

title: myColorado State App Cyberattack
description: Colorado's Office of Information Technology said hackers breached the myColorado app (digital ID, documents, state services), discovered on 18 November. The app was shut down and remained offline.
impact: App with 2.1 million users taken offline; data tied to nearly 150,000 people likely stolen.

title: Commercial Shipping Vessels Hacked (Suspected Iran)
description: US officials are investigating intelligence that up to 50 commercial vessels were compromised, potentially linked to Iran, reportedly via known Fortinet FortiGate vulnerabilities. FBI and Coast Guard boarded vessels bound for US ports.
impact: Up to 50 vessels compromised; no reported operational disruption or physical danger so far.

title: Check Point Management Servers Campaign (GT13)
description: GreyNoise reported an espionage-like campaign (GT13) exploiting multiple vulnerabilities to compromise two dozen Check Point Security management servers between 17 Oct and 2 Nov, believed ongoing.
impact: 22 organisations across 17 countries hit, including government, financial, energy, transport, mining and manufacturing.

title: Radware Cloud WAF API Breach
description: Radware said an unauthorised party accessed an internal Cloud WAF management API exposed to the internet without authentication on 19 November; credentials were revoked and replaced.
impact: Some customer account details and cloud access keys exposed.

title: Rackspace Spot Cloud Platform Breach
description: Rackspace is shutting down its Rackspace Spot Kubernetes platform after a breach let hackers access customer clusters and secrets.
impact: Customer Kubernetes clusters and secrets accessed; service to be permanently discontinued on 8 December 2026.

title: West Virginia Legislature Cyber Incident
description: West Virginia's state legislature responded to a cyberattack that began on 19 November, taking down its website; outside specialists engaged. No group has claimed it.
impact: Legislature website down and certain IT systems temporarily disabled; other state agencies unaffected.

title: European Commission Ongoing Cyberattack
description: Intrusion detected on 22 October is still spreading through Commission IT systems; sources say a China-backed group is suspected. First confirmed personal-data leak involves EU Academy users.
impact: Internal systems disrupted; EU Academy users' personal data leaked.

title: GlobeTopper Gift Card Platform Hack
description: iQSTEL's B2B digital gift card distributor GlobeTopper took its platform offline after an intrusion detected 22 October; attacker redeemed digital gift cards, per SEC filing.
impact: $70,000 in gift cards redeemed; ~$2.5 million estimated lost revenue.

title: Skagerak Energi Azure APIM Attack
description: Norway's NSM said hackers exploited a Microsoft Azure API Management flaw to target credentials and secrets at Norwegian organisations including Skagerak Energi and Equinor.
impact: Credentials/secrets targeted; Skagerak says operations and power production unaffected.

title: LaLiga Fan Services Platform Breach
description: Attacker accessed a LaLiga fan services platform between 14 and 16 November and extracted personal data of registered users of the league and several clubs.
impact: Personal data of fans exposed; number affected not disclosed.

title: Travelstart Customer Data Breach
description: Online travel agency Travelstart said criminals gained unauthorised access to customer information on 18 November; customers warned of impersonation scams.
impact: Customer information accessed; scale not disclosed.

title: Bromcom School Email Exposure
description: Have I Been Pwned quantified September's breach of UK education software supplier Bromcom via a legacy SSO registration component.
impact: 355,051 school staff and pupil email addresses exposed.

title: JAXA Earth Observation Data System Breach
description: JAXA disclosed that its public Earth-observation data system was breached on 18 November via a command-injection flaw; a backdoor was installed and the system taken offline.
impact: Account names and encrypted passwords of 2,000 users stolen.

title: Tower Records Japan Online Store Breach
description: Tower Records disclosed unauthorised access to its online store detected the previous Thursday; names, emails, membership IDs and shipping addresses leaked.
impact: About 11 million customer information items leaked; no card data.

title: CHU de Guadeloupe Cyberattack
description: Major cyberattack overnight 21–22 November encrypted databases and knocked out software, intranet and phones; Plan Blanc triggered and Paris prosecutor opened an inquiry.
impact: Hospital running in degraded mode; non-urgent care postponed.

title: Austrian Foreign Ministry Website Breach
description: Hackers breached a ministry website run by an external provider on 12–13 November, accessing names and official contact details of staff in Vienna and at missions abroad.
impact: Diplomats' contact details accessed; no public data affected.

title: RIKEN Fugaku Supercomputer Intrusion
description: Attackers reached Fugaku's internal network via a public status dashboard between 10 and 13 November, tampered with servers and installed malware; Fugaku taken offline.
impact: User account data and 430 SSH keys compromised; supercomputer offline.

title: Next Retail Supplier Cyber Incident
description: Next warned that hackers gained access to limited data through a technology supplier. Customer personal data not compromised.

title: Samsung Securities Customer Data Exposure
description: Exposed personal information of 8,241 customers including names, account numbers and driver's licence numbers.

title: Cleverbridge Payment Card Data Breach
description: Third-party access to stored payment card data including card numbers and CVVs.
impact: Payment card data of customers exposed.

title: KEPCO Customer Platform Breach
description: Personal data of about 1.52 million users leaked from customer platform and e-procurement system.

title: Binance Hot Wallet Theft
description: Approximately $6.3 billion drained from hot wallets; compromised engineer workstation suspected.

title: ARARA Email Delivery Service Breach
description: Up to 81.3 million email addresses leaked from Japanese email delivery platform serving ~380 clients.
impact: Massive email address exposure across clients.

title: Nitori Holdings Customer Records Breach
description: Up to 37.62 million customer records may have leaked; names, emails, addresses, phones.

title: DentaQuest Data Breach
description: Largest confirmed healthcare breach of 2026; ~15 million people affected.

title: Bybit Ethereum Cold Wallet Theft
description: Lazarus Group drained ~$1.46 billion in ETH from cold wallet via Safe{Wallet} UI compromise. Largest crypto theft at the time.

title: Change Healthcare Ransomware & Data Breach
description: 2024 ALPHV ransomware; confirmed 192.7 million people affected — largest US healthcare breach ever. Disrupted claims nationwide.

title: Conduent Business Services Breach
description: Access from Oct 2024–Jan 2025; ~62.2 million people affected. Files for healthcare and government clients stolen.
impact: Third-largest US healthcare breach; government services impacted.

title: Aflac Data Breach
description: ~22.65 million people notified; SSNs, health info, medical records exposed.
impact: Large insurance PHI and PII exposure.

title: Yale New Haven Health System Breach
description: 5.56 million individuals affected.

title: Episource Data Breach
description: Ransomware; 6.7 million people affected (health plans).

title: Blue Shield of California Breach
description: 4.7 million individuals affected via website tracking tools.

title: Jaguar Land Rover Cyberattack
description: Production halted for weeks; estimated £1.9–2.2bn economic impact.

title: Marks & Spencer Ransomware
description: Disrupted operations and payments; losses estimated £300–405m; customer data stolen.

title: Salesloft Drift / Salesforce Supply-Chain Attack
description: UNC6395 used compromised OAuth tokens from Drift integration to access Salesforce data at 700+ organizations including security firms.
impact: Widespread CRM and credential theft via supply chain.

title: Oracle EBS Zero-Day & Cloud Breaches
description: Cl0p and others exploited Oracle EBS and earlier Cloud identity systems; hundreds of organizations affected.

title: F5 BIG-IP Source Code Theft
description: Nation-state actors stole BIG-IP source code and undisclosed vulnerability info after long-term access.
impact: Elevated risk for F5 customers worldwide.

title: SK Telecom Subscriber Breaches
description: Nearly 27 million subscribers affected; risks of SIM cloning and identity theft.

title: Qantas Customer Data Breach
description: ~5.7 million customer records stolen via Salesforce platform; later leaked.

title: Asahi Group Ransomware
description: Disrupted industrial and logistics systems; data stolen.

title: PowerSchool Student Data Breach
description: Tens of millions of US K-12 students and teachers; SSNs, grades, medical info.

title: St. Paul MN Ransomware
description: City systems offline; data accessed; weeks of disruption.

title: Coupang Data Breach
description: Nearly 34 million customer records exposed.

title: DaVita Patient Data Breach
description: 2.7 million patients; SSNs, insurance, clinical records.

title: SimonMed Imaging Cyberattack
description: 1.27 million patients and 212GB data exfiltrated.

title: French Supermarket Refrigeration Attack
description: Refrigeration controllers at ~700 supermarkets switched to defrost; France attributed to Iran-linked actors.

title: Bitget Cryptocurrency Hack
description: ~$388 million drained via zero-day in third-party security products.

title: Denmark CPR Register Breach
description: Personal information of 8.8 million registered citizens exposed via misused access.

title: Pentagon DMDC Personnel Data Breach
description: Over 3 million DoD personnel records exposed.

title: CenterPoint Energy Data Theft
description: Customer data including SSNs via API; over 1 million Texans affected.

title: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Partner Access
description: Unauthorized access to ScreenConnect partner accounts; third-party extensions suspected.

title: Vanderbilt University Systems Restricted
description: Cyber incident restricted most systems; full restoration may take weeks.

title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Bank Heist
description: ~€100–118 million transferred via compromised third-party provider.

title: Capcom ID Data Breach
description: Over 11.7 million customer email addresses and account metadata exposed.

title: IDCF Cloud Ransomware Attack
description: Ransomware took down cloud region affecting 495 companies and local governments.

title: SBC Medical Group Data Breach
description: Personal and treatment records of 1.62 million people extracted.

title: FBI NCIC Database Intrusion Investigation
description: Apparent breach of National Crime Information Center investigated.

title: USDA Farm Payment Systems Incident
description: Outages of farmer payment, loan and crop insurance systems.

title: Optimizely Experimentation Supply-Chain Attack
description: Malicious JS injected into 178 organizations' sites including major media.
impact: Card skimming and malware delivery via trusted scripts.

title: Equinor Cyberattack
description: IT systems attacked; oil/gas production unaffected.

title: Rakuten Securities Customer Data Leak
description: Possible exposure of login IDs for 11.25M accounts and sensitive data for 4.47M.

title: Harvard University Alumni Data Breach
description: ~850,500 unique accounts exposed via phishing; alumni and donor data.

title: TransUnion Data Breach
description: ~4.46 million people affected.

title: University of Phoenix Data Breach
description: ~3.49 million people affected.

title: Collins Aerospace Check-in System Attack
description: Ransomware on vMUSE passenger processing; check-in outages at Heathrow, Brussels, Berlin, Dublin.

title: Kering Group (Gucci etc.) Data Breach
description: 7.4 million customer files from luxury brands exposed.

title: Red Hat Consulting GitLab Breach
description: 570 GB of data including customer engagement reports exfiltrated.
